thread:
IncBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: realtime-p99 latency breach detected for /v1/generate (us-east-1). p95=1.9s p99=3.8s (SLO p99<=1.5s). Spike started ~1917999960. Paging on-call.

Anya: i'm oncall, ack. i’ll take triage — grabbing dashboards / logs now.

Mike: looking at grafana: https://grafana.internal/r/latency-realtime?orgId=1 — big tail in us-east-1, sustained for ~90s. noticing concurrent rise in worker CPU and kv-cache miss rate.

Raj: noted. any recent rollouts? runtime deploys in last 30m?

DeployBot: Deploy finished: inference-runtime v3.14.2 to us-east-1 at 1917999800 by sophia.

Sophia: that was a small kernel fallback to enable a quantized path for large-ctx models, rolled to 10% canary.

Anya: ok flagging correlation: runtime canary + increase in cache miss. quick checks: if canary traffic routed to small subset of machines, tail latency could spike due to cold KV caches. can we confirm pool identities?

Mike: running quick log query:
```
logs.query("service:inference AND route:/v1/generate AND latency_ms>1500") | group_by(model, host) | count()
```
Result: spike concentrated on hosts inference-ust-04 and inference-ust-05 running v3.14.2 (canary).

Raj: got it. examining host metrics — disk-backed kv-cache misses up 6x on those hosts, and GPU utilization is high but not saturated. suggests cache thrash rather than pure compute.

Oliver: streaming paths show stalls at kv cache fetch and a lot of reconnects in the chunked stream layer for those hosts.

Anya: mitigation plan: 1) cut canary to 0% (stop routing new requests to v3.14.2), 2) scale up warm pool to absorb traffic for 2-3min, 3) enable temporary rate limit at edge for unknown heavy routes if needed.

Sophia: agree. rolling canary back now.

DeployBot: Rollout command issued: routing:canary set v3.14.2 -> 0% (applied).

Mike: scaling warm pool:
```
kubectl -n inference scale deployment inference-warm-pool --replicas=30
```
Scale command issued to k8s.

Anya: also bumping prefix cache ttl to reduce cold misses on remaining canary machines:
```
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/cache/ttl -d '{"prefix":"/v1/generate","ttl":300}'
```

Raj: started a rolling restart of inference-ust-04/05 to flush kv cache and ensure fresh kernel libs.

Mike: metrics trending down — p99 dropped from 3.8s -> 1.6s within 30s of rollback+scale. still above SLO but close.

Anya: customer impact: estimated ~0.6% of requests in us-east over last 2m breached p99 SLO. flagging urgency low->medium. notifying support for potential user contacts.

Sophia: opening a short RCA thread for runtime canary path: looks like the quantized fallback path increases KV working set size unexpectedly for long context requests.

Oliver: capturing sample traces: attach span ids: span_0a9f.. span_0aaf.. (p99 traces saved to /traces/1918000000).

Mike: follow-up actions: 1) hold v3.14.2 canary until root cause fixed, 2) add early health check in routing for kv-cache miss spikes, 3) add alert to detect canary-host-specific p99 divergence.

Anya: oncall handoff note: i'm taking this to stabilize. if any downstream regressions pop up i'll page oncall-engineering. leaving a runbook snippet below for followups.

Runbook snippet:
- If p99 > 2s for >60s and associated canary hosts show kv_cache_miss_ratio > 3x baseline: set canary=0%, scale warm pool +20%, restart canary hosts.
- If p99 remains >3s after mitigation: escalate to eng-runtime and ship a rollback to prior runtime.

Sophia: I'll own the runtime fix and follow up with ML infra to check quantization path memory working set.

Anya: closing alert in 2m if no regressions. thanks all — good quick mitigation. :thumbsup:

IncBot: Incident note: mitigation actions recorded. Incident state: mitigated->monitoring.

Mike: leaving final stats for handoff: window 1917999960-1918000120, total requests: 1,240,987, breached p99: 7,402 (~0.6%). Post-mitigation p99 1.2s.

Anya: handing off to oncall-rotation-2 at 1918000200. any follow-ups after 30m postmortem.

Oliver: +1 will add trace samples to RCA doc.

Sophia: will schedule runtime revert PR if we can't get small patch in 24h.

Anya: thanks everyone. I'll file the incident ticket and add triage notes. :white_check_mark:
